title: Vessels x Dorian LPG
description: Title slide — Maritime intelligence for the VLGC fleet
speakerNotes:
- Open by naming the audience: Dorian LPG, NYSE LPG, the Hadjipateras family business.
- Land the one-line proposition: visibility, sanctions cover, freight intelligence for the VLGC fleet.
- Set tone: this is a working session, not a marketing pitch.

title: Why we are in the room
description: Acknowledgement of Dorian's position and exposure surface
speakerNotes:
- Acknowledge the fleet they built: 25+ modern VLGCs, dual-fuel LPG propulsion, Helios Pool.
- Name the trade lane: USG to Far East arbitrage.
- Frame the risk surface: sanctioned-adjacent waters, gray-fleet counterparties, STS transfers.

title: The compliance perimeter moved
description: Three macro pressures on the gas-carrier compliance perimeter
speakerNotes:
- OFAC LPG sanctions have widened materially since 2024.
- Dark-fleet behavior is migrating from crude tankers into the gas-carrier segment.
- Insurers and trade-finance banks now require voyage-level, not annual, evidence.

title: Dorian today
description: Listing, fleet, commercial structure, trade lane snapshot
speakerNotes:
- NYSE LPG, listed 2014, Stamford and Athens.
- 25+ modern VLGCs, ECO and LPG dual-fuel.
- Helios LPG Pool for commercial management.
- US Gulf to Far East as the dominant arbitrage lane.

title: Six surfaces of exposure
description: Where a single bad signal becomes a real problem
speakerNotes:
- Walk the six exposure surfaces quickly.
- Stress: any one of them, unmonitored, is a headline or a P and I issue.
- This is the surface Vessels is built to cover end to end.

title: What Vessels is
description: One operating layer: tracking, screening, provenance
speakerNotes:
- One line: one operating layer for visibility, screening, and voyage-level provenance.
- Wired into your existing workflow, not a replacement for it.

title: Fleet tracking
description: AIS, satellite, port-call fusion across 1,200+ gas carriers
speakerNotes:
- Terrestrial AIS, satellite AIS, and port-call data fused.
- 1,200+ gas carriers, 15-second median refresh.
- Replay voyages, diff against filed plans, alert on deviations.

title: Sanctions screening
description: OFAC, EU, UK, UN, port-state and UBO feeds, continuous
speakerNotes:
- Every list that matters, live, not annual.
- Walk the sample screen: charterer, vessel, UBO hops, risk score, action.
- Each screen produces a signed receipt your team can defend.

title: Dark vessel detection
description: AIS gap forensics, STS rendezvous inference, SAR cross-check
speakerNotes:
- Show the AIS gap pattern: vessel goes dark, four-hour gap, comes back.
- Cross-check with SAR satellite, find the second hull alongside.
- Counterparty is sanctioned. The system flagged the gap before the insurer asked.

title: Voyage economics
description: Baltic LPG, Mt Belvieu, Argus FE, bunker spreads
speakerNotes:
- Baltic LPG, Mt Belvieu, Argus FE, bunker spreads wired in.
- Pre-fixture TCE per option, sensitivity to bunker spread.
- Note clearly: the chart values are illustrative of feed structure, not today's print.

title: Counterparty due diligence
description: UBO graph traversal and composite risk score
speakerNotes:
- Every counterparty walked all the way up the ownership chain.
- Show the three-hop UBO match that ends at an SDN entity.
- Composite risk score: sanctions distance, PEP, port-state history, AIS behaviour, adverse media.

title: SZL trust receipts
speakerNotes:
- This is the moat. Every screen and every decision is hashed at the source.
- Chained, tamper-evident, verifiable.
- When an examiner asks what you knew and when, you hand them an answer, not a screenshot folder.

title: Workflow fit
speakerNotes:
- Three desks at Dorian, one operating layer.
- Chartering: faster fixtures with the math.
- Operations: see the gap before the email.
- Compliance and legal: defensible by default.

title: 90-day pilot proposal
description: Three vessels, capped fee, returnable against year-one
speakerNotes:
- Ninety days. Three vessels. A live answer, not a slide.
- Two weeks to wire up, six weeks live, two weeks readout.
- Capped pilot fee, returnable against year-one. Full data export on exit, no lock-in.

title: Why Vessels
description: Shared platform, maritime-first, receipts as primitive
speakerNotes:
- We sit in the same operating family as A11oy and Sentra. Shared identity, shared receipts.
- Maritime-first domain model, not a generic CRM with a shipping skin.
- Receipts as a primitive, not a feature.
- Open data export. If we ever fail you, you walk with everything.

title: Next steps
description: Pick three vessels — live in two weeks
speakerNotes:
- Decision today: pilot scope and vessel selection.
- Decision next week: compliance and IT sign-off, short-form MSA.
- Decision in ninety days: fleet-wide rollout under the Helios pool.
